g.title: SimulatorPipeline
g.text: Entry: main.py test_sim → simulator_testing() → SimulationContext state machine (Initializing → Running → Finishing) → per-day command chain

g.title: cluster_day
g.text: — run_day(context): for command in commands: command.execute(context)

g.title: end
g.text: summary table · JSON logs · GUI payload

g.title: worker_init
g.text: Worker init: share Lock / Counter / Manager.dict,

g.title: seed
g.text: Seed random / numpy / torch with sim.seed

g.title: agg
g.text: Per policy: mean / std over samples

g.title: models
g.text: (am / ddam / ptr / transformer) or none for classical policies

g.title: restore
g.text: bins, model_tup, cached, overflows, daily_log, run_time

g.title: daycx
g.text: (bins, coords, dist matrices, time matrix, n_vehicles,

g.title: after
g.text: Copy back bins / new_data / overflows / cached

g.title: pseed
g.text: policy_seed = (seed + adler32(canonical policy name) + day) mod 2³¹

g.title: summ
g.text: (cost, collected, overflows, lost, reward, kg/km, time_spent …)

g.title: fill
g.text: pre-sampled ground-truth fills (+ noisy sensor fills)
update running mean / std per bin
clip at 100 % → overflow flags, lost waste

g.title: rc_key
g.text: Resolve solver key: policy.type / policy.solver / engine
or registry match on compound name

g.title: sel_out
g.text: context: mandatory = list of bin ids

g.title: rc_exec
g.text: BaseRoutingPolicy: load area params (capacity, R, C)
→ subset problem (mandatory-only, or full graph if vrpp)
→ map local routes back to global tour

g.title: col_norm
g.text: Normalise tour: ensure depot at both ends
time_spent = driving time (time matrix or km / speed)

g.title: col_do
g.text: reset visited bins to 0, profit = kg·R − km·C
